skill_name: Describe an algorithm that sorts numbers in an array.
workflow: A sorting algorithm is a type of algorithm that takes an array of unsorted numbers as input and produces an array of numbers sorted in ascending or descending order as output. Common sorting algorithms include bubble sort, merge sort, quick sort, and selection sort. Bubble sort works by repeatedly going through the array, comparing pairs of elements, and swapping them if they are out of order; this continues until the array is sorted.
